evidence.detail: The launcher target exactly matches the checked-out HEAD: b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a. The working tree was clean.
M2 traceability covers all five approved work items: delegated-scope reduction, app-only token acquisition, server endpoint integration, UI integration, and documentation finalization.
The milestone record reports 173 passing tests, successful compilation, and successful governance validation, but binds those results to product SHA 98be0bc rather than the launcher target.

Independent execution of the full test suite failed because the read-only sandbox prohibits loopback socket binding and provides no writable temporary directory. The failure was environmental rather than an observed assertion failure.
The independently runnable non-socket suites completed successfully: 100 tests across auth, analyzer, graph, and UI safety passed.
evidence.reference: python3 -m unittest tests.test_auth tests.test_analyzer tests.test_graph tests.test_ui_safety

evidence.detail: Independent compilation could not run because py_compile requires cache-file writes prohibited by the sandbox.
Independent governance validation could not complete because its launcher smoke tests require a writable temporary directory.

Source inspection confirms app-only session supersession, stable provider-error mapping, retained-secret renewal, logout clearing, and stale-response generation guards, with corresponding focused tests.
Source inspection confirms the browser clears the secret after validation failures, settled or rejected requests, mode changes, and logout, and uses text-only rendering for untrusted policy data.
The release documentation describes prerequisites, session-only secret retention, rotation/revocation, certificate-auth deferral, both walkthroughs, and the applicable residual risks.

evidence: The launcher requires review of b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a, while the milestone's recorded test, compile, governance, and smoke evidence is explicitly bound to 98be0bc.
The target record still contains the unresolved placeholder <FREEZE-SHA>.
This shallow/grafted checkout does not contain 98be0bc, so the claimed byte identity between that commit and the reviewed target cannot be independently established.
Repository rules require real checks against the exact candidate and prohibit PASS when target identity or evidence is stale or unverifiable.
findings.remediation: Replace <FREEZE-SHA> with b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a and record successful test, compile, governance, and applicable smoke evidence against that exact commit, or provide independently verifiable tree-identity evidence that the governed workflow explicitly accepts as commit-bound evidence.
findings.title: Milestone package lacks exact-target verification evidence
findings.verification: From a clean checkout of b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a in an environment permitting loopback sockets, bytecode/temp writes, run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests, python3 -m py_compile $(git ls-files '*.py'), and python3 scripts/validate_repo.py; record commands, exit statuses, relevant output, and the exact SHA in project/milestones/M2.md.

limitations: The checkout is shallow/grafted and contains only the target commit, so ancestry, issue merge history, diffs from the approved roadmap commit, and the claimed product-tree identity with 98be0bc562de8f7cf52e3019715bc4cff571ad91 could not be independently verified.

The full 173-test suite could not complete because 73 socket-dependent server tests and temporary-directory-dependent tests were blocked by sandbox restrictions; 100 independently runnable tests passed.
py_compile and governance validation could not complete because the read-only environment prohibits required cache and temporary-directory writes.
No live tenant authentication or Microsoft Graph fetch was performed. The roadmap identifies this as a protected action and accepted residual evidence gap, not an M2 completion criterion.
No browser automation was available; runtime UI evidence therefore remains dependent on the recorded human walkthrough and static tests.
Base commit was supplied as empty, so no base-to-target diff could be reviewed.
review.summary: M2 appears requirement-complete and the independently runnable 100-test subset passes, with no additional product defect identified by source inspection. The review is BLOCKED because the milestone record remains bound to a different verification SHA, retains an unresolved freeze placeholder, and the sandbox prevented independent execution of all required checks against the launcher target.
